about_the_game:
Another's Memories is a first-person psychological horror video game located in Argentina. Explore a sinister country house, solve puzzles, and survive ruthless enemies in an immersive experience where every shadow hides a disturbing story.

Environment

The game takes place in a big house, a place steeped in mystery and suffering. Its rooms and corridors hold traces of sadistic rituals and memories that do not belong to you.

Story

You were returning home on Route 2 when a flat tyre forced you to stop. Suddenly, a shock knocked you unconscious. When you wake up, you find yourself locked in the basement of an unfamiliar house. Without knowing why you are there, you must find a way out while fragments of strange memories begin to blend with your own.

Enemies

You are not alone. Disturbing shadows, figures that freeze under your gaze, and entities that will not hesitate to chase you until they catch you. Each enemy has unique patterns and avoiding them will be essential. Observe, hide, and move carefully.

Gameplay

Another's Memories offers a first-person psychological horror experience focused on exploration, tension and survival. Interact with objects, solve puzzles, discover hidden secrets and deal with situations that challenge your perception. Each discovery will bring you closer to the truth, although knowing it may condemn you.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains scenes of violence, death, and elements of psychological horror. It also includes representations of suicide, rituals, and disturbing situations that may be disruptive or inappropriate for some audiences.
